stage.name: Qualification Battle
stage.description:
Qualification is on the line. The atmosphere is tense, both on the field and in the stands.
<Smart Stadium> Smartref appears on the field, picking up nearby balls and shooting them towards the opponent's side of the field.
<Penalty Shootout> Game is decided by penalty shootout if the two sides are tied when time runs out.
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

straight_line_club_determined_shooter.name: Straight Line Club Determined Shooter
straight_line_club_determined_shooter.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. Best not to stand in the way of their 'cannonball' shots if you don't want to get hurt.
abilities: Shots are more powerful; only kicks the ball in a horizontal straight line.

straight_line_club_shooter.name: Straight Line Club Shooter
straight_line_club_shooter.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. Most of their players are engineers, and going direct is not so much a tactic as a subconscious expression.
abilities: Shots are more powerful; only kicks the ball in a horizontal straight line.

straight_line_club_goalie.name: Straight Line Club Goalie
straight_line_club_goalie.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. They are unconcerned with how people view their goalkeeping ability, yet quite proud of their record for the longest goalkeeper kickoff.
abilities: Kickoffs are more powerful; only kicks the ball in a horizontal straight line.

decisive_moment_ball.name: Decisive Moment Ball
decisive_moment_ball.flavourText: Football designed for penalty shootouts in order to enrich the match experience. The smart chip automatically shows the countdown, magnified to make it clear to both players and fans that the most exciting moment is upon us.
abilities: On your turn: 10s countdown, changes direction of shot when attacked during this time; fires automatically when the timer ends.
Enemy turn: Can be kicked by opposing players

straight_line_club_determined_goalie.name: Straight Line Club Determined Goalie
straight_line_club_determined_goalie.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. They have published a paper claiming that long kickoffs help reduce the chance of being scored against, and are happy to put theory into practice.
abilities: Kickoffs are more powerful; only kicks the ball in a horizontal straight line.

straight_line_club_hitter.name: Straight Line Club Hitter
straight_line_club_hitter.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. They can only clear obstacles in a straight line, so the obvious solution is to put in more players, to cover the entire field.

compressed_ball.name: Compressed Ball
compressed_ball.flavourText: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.
abilities: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

originite_prime_ball.name: Originite Prime Ball
originite_prime_ball.flavourText: A football that looks like Originite Prime to enrich the match experience. Not actual Originium, so it is perfectly safe and does not explode.
abilities: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

perpetual_rebounder.name: Perpetual Rebounder
perpetual_rebounder.flavourText: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!
abilities: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

rma70_spikeball.name: RMA70 Spikeball
rma70_spikeball.flavourText: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abilities: Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

straight_line_club_determined_hitter.name: Straight Line Club Determined Hitter
straight_line_club_determined_hitter.flavourText: Straight Line Club's players are trying to prove that limited vision does not compromise their ability to play. They are unconcerned with opponents trying to dribble past them; all they care about is the opponent standing in their way, whom they will mow down mercilessly.

will_of_the_north_ball.name: Will of the North Ball
will_of_the_north_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?
abilities: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
